focus_areas: Text coherence on the sticker (primary artifact indicator).
Geometric perfection of the circular silhouette and planarity.
Texture realism of the vulcanized rubber surface.
Spatial grounding of the sticker on the puck surface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the sticker. If the OCR expert confirms it is gibberish, this is a strong negative signal for image authenticity despite the correct geometric shape of the puck. Evaluate if the lighting on the sticker matches the ambient lighting of the scene. Additionally, verify via the depth auditor that the sticker does not appear to float above the puck surface.
image_description: A top-down view of a black hockey puck on a white background. The puck has a matte texture with some visible scuffs and wear marks. A white rectangular sticker is adhered to the center of the top face, containing distorted, illegible text that resembles 'BRUINS' or similar lettering but is structurally incoherent.
